description: Carrier Strike: briefing, radio calls and outcome text.

briefing: {enemy} carrier {target} is parked in {system} and its air wing is the reason {client} cannot move a convoy in the sector. A bomber wing will go in. You are their escort. Keep the bombers alive until the {target} is dead.
Kill the {target}. The bombers can do it, but only if their escorts keep the fighters off them. Expect the {target} to launch as soon as it sees us.
The {target} has to go before {client} can move on {system}. The bomber wing has the ordnance. You are the reason it arrives. Stay close and fly like it.
success: The {target} breaks in half and the {enemy} fighters scatter without a deck to land on. {client} pays {captain} the full strike fee.
The {target} is gone. {client} rates the strike a success and the bomber wing buys you a round at {station}.
Flames from the {target} light the whole sector. {client} pays and orders a formal commendation, which will take months.
failure: The {target} survives and its wing is intact. {client} will need a bigger plan and a different escort.
The bomber wing is gone and the {target} is still launching. {client} pays only for flying hours.
radio-bombers: Strike wing, this is Lead. Escorts, stay tight. We go in on the {target}.
Bombers are on the run in. Escorts, keep your noses up and your eyes open.
Bomber Lead to escort. We have the ordnance. We need you for the rest.
radio-carrier: There is the {target}. One frigate for company, four fighters on combat patrol.
{target} sighted. Rated carrier class, deck lights on. Press in.
Contact. That is the {target}, and it is not alone.
radio-launch: The {target} has launched. Eight interceptors, heading straight for the bombers.
Fighters off the deck. Pick your targets and protect the wing.
Enemy fighters in the air. Bomber Lead says they will lose the run if they are hit.
radio-jump: Jump flash, left. Cruiser and gunships. They are reinforcing the {target}.
{enemy} cruiser dropping in. This just got harder.
More hulls inbound. Bombers, stay on your line.
radio-rearguard: The {target} is dead. Remaining fighters are making a last pass. Clear them.
Carrier is down. Mop up, then we go home.
Their deck is gone. Fighters are looking for somewhere to land. Do not let them.
